alex-customer: Hi @support — we were invoiced for 18,540 tokens on INV-2026-03-05-293 but our dashboard shows 6,120 tokens for the same day. We think retries caused duplicate billing. Sample request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Can someone confirm?

jess-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request timestamps + any request headers you have? Invoice number helps, thanks.

alex-customer: Invoice INV-2026-03-05-293, timestamps around 2026-03-05T14:22:10Z. From our client logs:
```
2026-03-05T14:22:10Z DEBUG send req_id=req_0a1b2c3d attempt=1
2026-03-05T14:22:15Z WARN timeout, retrying attempt=2
2026-03-05T14:22:20Z INFO success req_id=req_0a1b2c3d attempt=2 tokens=870
```
We call the text.generate endpoint (non-idempotent) using the official SDK v0.9.1, which retries on socket timeouts by default.

leo-billing: I pulled the billing logs for INV-2026-03-05-293. We have three recorded ingest events for the same customer around that window with identical payload hashes but different internal request_ids (billing_req_764, billing_req_765, billing_req_766). They each show ~870 tokens, which explains the extra ~12k tokens. Looks like retries were billed as independent calls.

maria-platform: This matches an earlier pattern — gateway retries + client retries can replay the request to the model if there is no idempotency key. Our gateway currently retries on 504s for edge timeouts and doesn't attach an idempotency header. From the edge logs:
```
edge-req=req_0a1b2c3d gateway-retries=2 upstream-status=200 504->200 path=/v1/text.generate headers="X-Retry: true, X-Idempotency-Key: -"
```
So gateway attempted replay and the final upstream success happened multiple times (downstream counted each success).

nolan-infra: Quick repro steps I used locally:
1) call text.generate with no `Idempotency-Key` header and force socket timeout on first attempt via tbf.
2) SDK retries kick in -> gateway also configured to retry -> upstream receives N completions.
Example curl that reproduces the double-exec:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/text.generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":100}'
# run a network fault causing the client to retry, gateway will also replay
```

jess-support: Thanks — immediate question: do we credit the customer or adjust billing pipeline to dedupe?

leo-billing: Short term: issue a credit for duplicated tokens on INV-2026-03-05-293. I estimate ~12,420 tokens duplicated -> credit that unit count. I'll create a manual credit line once infra confirms exact request mapping.

maria-platform: Medium term: two orthogonal fixes:
- Require/propagate `Idempotency-Key` on all text/generate & chat completions. Reject requests without it when retries likely.
- Change gateway retry policy: do not re-send non-idempotent POSTs on 5xx/504. Only retry idempotent endpoints or when upstream is definitely idempotent.
Also add dedupe in billing: map upstream-request-hash + idempotency-key + 5 minute window to collapse repeated completions into single billed event.

nolan-infra: I'll open infra ticket PLAT-2348 to change gateway retry behavior and ensure X-Idempotency-Key header is logged into request tracing. ETA: patch in staging by 2026-03-08, prod rollout 2026-03-11 (can accelerate if needed).

leo-billing: Filing billing adjustment now: BILL-5678. I'll hold credits until infra confirms mapping.

jess-support: Action items recap: 
- leo-billing -> issue provisional credit for INV-2026-03-05-293 (BILL-5678) by EOD.
- nolan-infra -> PLAT-2348 to stop gateway replays + log idempotency header.
- maria-platform -> add billing dedupe design doc and require idempotency header in SDK + API docs.
- jess-support -> send interim note to customer with ETA and ticket numbers.

alex-customer: Thanks — please include that the credit is applied before we escalate to our finance team. Appreciate the fast follow.

deploy-bot: PROD deploy: gateway v1.12.4 -> switched default retry policy for POSTs off for text endpoints (canary). changelist PLAT-2348-1.

maria-platform: Confirming we merged a billing-side dedupe PoC to staging; it collapses duplicate events by (payload-hash + idempotency-key if present) within a 300s window.

leo-billing: Credit processed: INV-2026-03-05-293 credit_id=CR-2026-03-05-102 amount_tokens=12420. Customer invoice updated; refund issued to payment method on file. Marking BILL-5678 resolved.

jess-support: Closing loop — alex, the credit CR-2026-03-05-102 should appear on your account within 2-3 business days. Long-term fixes are tracked under PLAT-2348 and PLAT-BILL-449. Please re-open if anything else. :white_check_mark:

alex-customer: Got it — thanks to everyone for the quick triage. We'll test again after SDK update and idempotency docs.

jess-support: Closing thread.
